mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT P JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON P.PRODUCT_ID = OI.PRODUCT_ID SET P.PRODUCT_STOCK = P.PRODUCT_STOCK - OI.ORDER_ITEM_QTY WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
